description: Experimental TF3 multiplayer prototype. Probe v34 / bridge v12: prepared sessions verify game, multiplayer package, installed mods and source save before exchanging actions. Detailed world digests detect persistent content differences. v33 syncs loans through the game's loan script, orders replays of both PCs, compares vehicle positions, cargo and towns, and v34 holds builds so that both games execute them at a common tick.
name: Multiplayer Probe (dev)
summary: Logs the TF3 Lua sandbox and engine API for multiplayer research.
